title: Does this fixed theta Mellin interpolation pass the Pick gate?
question: Enclose the four-point Loewner matrix for the exact function below, including quadrature and all omitted-region errors. Does the displayed integer vector certify failure of positive semidefiniteness? State exactly which research route that excludes and which claims remain undecided.

definitions.interpolation: f(u) = (u-1/2)*U(2*u-2)/U(2*u), u>1/2. The witness excludes a Pick extension agreeing on this interval.
definitions.necessary_condition: A Pick extension analytic and real on this interval requires L positive semidefinite.

certificate_gate: The upper endpoint of v^T*L*v must be strictly negative, with every denominator moment positive and every matrix-entry radius below 1e-8.

excluded_on_certification: This exact interpolation's complete-Bernstein and KPS BP1 route
Positive Stieltjes representations of f(u)/u or 1/f(u)
undecided: Different interpolations, including ones agreeing only at positive integers
Other Mellin or van Dantzig routes

references.title: Schilling, Song and Vondracek, Bernstein Functions: Theory and Applications, 2nd edition (2012)
references.scope: Pick/complete-Bernstein/Stieltjes and operator-monotone correspondences: Theorems 6.2, 6.9, 7.3 and 12.17.

references.title: Konstantopoulos, Patie and Sarkar, A new class of solutions to the van Dantzig problem, the Lee-Yang property, and the Riemann hypothesis (2024)
references.scope: Equation (4.14) defines BP1 with a mandatory Pick condition; Theorem 4.4 supplies the selected sufficient route.

references.title: FLINT, acb_calc: calculus with complex numbers
references.scope: Rigorous complex-ball integration behind python-flint's acb.integral.
